metaDescription: Farm owners post management requests. Professional managers apply with proposals reviewed by FarmExit.
title: Management marketplace
description: Owners seek farm managers and agricultural engineers. FarmExit reviews each request before it is published. This is not a general job board.
trustNote: Sample requests shown for layout review until public management discovery APIs are available.
notLiveBody: Farm management requests exist today as private owner submissions reviewed by FarmExit staff. There is no approved public API to browse published management opportunities or to apply as a manager from this website.
